name: apex
description: Seven cohesive APEX skills for governed project work, solution shaping, Git, subagents, debugging, and testing.
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code adapter for APEX:

- Load `using-apex` through the native `Skill` tool.
- Use `AskUserQuestion` only when an APEX decision genuinely requires user input.
- Use `Agent` for an authorized APEX subagent role: `coder` for bounded implementation or review, `explore` for read-only investigation, and `plan` for read-only planning or architecture.
- Run independent agents concurrently only when they have no shared mutable state.
- Use the repository and runtime tools actually exposed; do not translate examples into guessed tool names or parameters.

interface.shortDescription: Governed software engineering workflows for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Use seven cohesive APEX skills to govern substantial work and select focused shaping, Git, subagent, debugging, and testing workflows.
